evals.prompt: Live-test the Dark Grotto through the Verdette Caverns in the browser with a few tester agents in parallel. I want a report and issues filed for anything real.
evals.expected_output: Clarifying questions on browser surface, scope end, fix-vs-report and hard sections; preflight run; two stacks on accepted ports with a config per start state; a primer and 4-5 tester briefs dispatched concurrently; orchestrator re-verification of contested findings; a docs/qa report, filed issues, memory update, and teardown.

evals.prompt: The nomad camp conversations changed on this branch. Get a couple of agents to play through Mara, Devet and Liss on desktop and on a phone viewport and tell me what broke.
evals.expected_output: A pre-seeded leg config starting one tile before the camp transition; desktop + --mobile testers on one stack with the accepted Vite port; LLM exchange budgets stated; voice grading against ai/npc/human/*.json; verification of any Critical on a clean client before reporting.

evals.prompt: One of the testers says combat never ends in the client and the console is full of 400s. Is that real?
evals.expected_output: Checks the tester's stack Vite port against Config.CORS_ORIGINS and the API log for 'not an accepted origin' before treating it as a product bug; if it is the origin fault, marks the tester's combat findings contaminated and re-verifies on an accepted port.
